purpose: Fixed broad exposure proxy, not fitted correlations or a product profitability whitelist
admission: Keep one opportunity per symbol; additionally at most one concurrent opportunity in each sector and direction. Opposite directions share symbol limit but not sector-direction slot.
ties: Entry interval end, warning timestamp, then event_key ascending. Reverse event_key sensitivity also reported. No sorting by future PnL or retrospective preferred symbols.
unknown_exposure: Same conservative maximum-horizon reservation as existing capacity research
